hypothesis: Qwen TCB prefill already computes the greedy next-token decision for the final prompt token, but the plain decode loop discards it and re-feeds that final prompt token at prompt_len. This inserts one extra KV position and explains the third-token divergence against the conventional Gravity generate loop despite matched layer surfaces. An opt-in conventional seed that emits the final prefill decision and feeds the emitted token at prompt_len should restore same-model continuation parity.
